comparison.objective: Pack three cases into two locker bays while ensuring nothing rests on the fragile blue case.
comparison.physical_skill: Plan stacking order and place rigid cases flat in tight bays versus fine tool use and iterative mechanical adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Requires all cases stowed with at most two per bay and no grey case loading the blue one; no dynamic-response test. Rubric is numeric, though simulated glass breakage is only a scored rule.
comparison.reason: It tests constrained packing and load-path reasoning rather than damper setting, locking, and verification.
